glm-5.2.description: Zhipu GLM-5.2, served natively on Inference.net's own infrastructure. This is the exact model used in the request-body example on the vendor's own API quickstart (https://docs.inference.net/api/api-quickstart, retrieved 2026-09-28: `baseURL: "https://api.inference.net/v1"`, `model: "glm-5.2"`, streaming chat via the OpenAI SDK), so it is picked as the catalog default over an arbitrary roster pick. context_length/max_completion_tokens/pricing read from the live, unauthenticated GET https://api.inference.net/v1/models on 2026-09-28 (200, 63 models). input_modalities is ["text"] only for this model — no image/video support documented. Not live capability-probed (credential-free onboarding, no key used).

glm-5.3.description: Zhipu GLM-5.3 — newer GLM generation on the same live roster; one of only a handful of models whose supported_endpoints spans chat, responses and messages together (per the live /v1/models payload, 2026-09-28). input_modalities text-only. Roster-listed and priced from the vendor's own /v1/models response; not itself capability-probed.

glm-5.3-flash.description: Zhipu GLM-5.3 Flash — cheapest model on the roster and the only one of the eight cataloged here whose live /v1/models entry lists input_modalities ["text","image","video"] (2026-09-28 GET), so it is the one model in this entry marked vision: true; not itself capability-probed end to end (no key used).

llama-3.3-70b-instruct.description: Meta Llama 3.3 70B Instruct, open-weight — widely-recognized baseline fallback. Roster-listed with no cached-input price on the live /v1/models payload (2026-09-28); input_modalities text-only.

deepseek-v3.2.description: DeepSeek V3.2, open-weight — roster-listed fallback from the live /v1/models GET (2026-09-28); input_modalities text-only.

gpt-4.1-mini.description: OpenAI GPT-4.1 mini, reachable through Inference.net's hosted gateway under the same Bearer-key API (the vendor's quickstart separately documents a 'proxy mode' with extra x-inference-provider* headers for BYO provider keys — not used here; this catalog entry only relies on the plain gateway call). Live /v1/models (2026-09-28) lists input_modalities ["text","image"], so marked vision: true; not capability-probed end to end.

gemini-2.5-flash.description: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash, reachable through the same gateway. Live /v1/models (2026-09-28) lists input_modalities ["text","image"], so marked vision: true; not capability-probed end to end.

claude-haiku-4-5.description: Anthropic Claude Haiku 4.5, reachable through the same gateway; the live /v1/models payload notes Claude-family entries list only the "messages" supported_endpoint (2026-09-28). input_modalities ["text","image"], so marked vision: true; not capability-probed end to end.

errorRules.message: Invalid Inference.net API key. Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Get one at {setupUrl}

instructions: 2. Create an Inference.net project API key from the dashboard (this is the gateway key that goes in {apiKeyEnvVar} — do not confuse it with a third-party provider key used only for the separate 'proxy mode')
3. New accounts start on a pay-as-you-go, $0-usage tier (1M included gateway requests/month, 30 req/min) per https://inference.net/pricing; confirm current terms before heavy use
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.inference.net/v1 (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`), serving 63 models on the live roster across many upstream families — Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Nemotron, plus Inference.net's own Schematron structured-extraction models — behind one API. A separate 'proxy mode' can forward to your own provider key via x-inference-provider* headers; not used by this catalog entry.

rosterVerified.method: unauthenticated GET https://api.inference.net/v1/models — 63 models; credential-free, no key used
